title: xldr mapping specification
description: How one input file is parsed and how its records map onto database tables. Add "$schema" to a spec.json to have an editor validate it; the reader ignores members it does not know.

mapping.description: The record mappings; a spec without any parses but loads nothing.

transform.description: Procedures to call once the input has been loaded, in the order written. Usually absent.

input.description: How an input file is turned into records. How those files arrive - which names the feed claims, and whether a marker announces them - is deployment rather than mapping and lives in the feed's delivery.properties, which the server reads.

properties.description: Settings of the adapter the mimeType selects, e.g. fieldSeparator, header, charset, dateFormat, numberFormat, locale, linesPerRecord, ns.<prefix>. Each value is taken as its text.

vars.description: Values evaluated once per load and referenced from a field mapping by {"var": "name"}.

selector.description: Where the records are, for an input that has to be pointed at: an XPath, a JSON pointer, a sheet range. A flat input uses a discriminator instead, and no record selector has both. Never blank: to mean every record, leave it out.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

selector.description: The adapter's own syntax: an XPath, a character range, a JSON pointer, a cell reference, or the name of a column. Exactly one of selector and nth. Never blank; say nth instead of counting on a blank one.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

nth.description: The n-th component of the record, counted from one: the n-th field of a separated line, the n-th column of a spreadsheet record counted from its range, the n-th element of a JSON array, the n-th child element. Exactly one of selector and nth.

dataType.description: The Java type the value is delivered as; matched case-insensitively, absent means text.

var.description: A named value computed once at the start of a load. Evaluated with no record in hand, so it may not read a fieldSelector - at any depth, including a lookup's key and a call's arguments.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

recordSelector.description: The name of a record selector of the input.

limit.description: At most this many records are inserted for this mapping.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

fieldMapping.description: One target column and exactly one source for its value.

fieldSelector.description: The name of a field selector of the record.

var.description: The name of an input var.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

lookup.description: A value read from a reference table, keyed by exactly one source. A key matching no row yields NULL.

column.description: The column whose value is taken.

keyColumn.description: The column the key is matched against.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

constant.description: A fixed value; its Java type follows the JSON literal. null loads a SQL NULL into the column.

expr.description: A ${...} template: interpolation of xldr.* ambient values, vars and - per row - fields, plus nextval('name'[, start[, inc]]) and now().

discriminator.description: Which records of a flat input are of this kind: which component of the record to look at, and what its value has to be. Exactly one of nth and selector, and exactly one of equals and matches.

selector.description: The component tested, by name, which needs a header. Never blank; say nth to count the component instead.

equals.description: The value that column holds, exactly.

matches.description: A regular expression the whole value matches.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next.

nth.description: The component tested, counted from one.

fn.description: A function in the target database, called once per load through JDBC's {? = call name(?)} escape and bound as a parameter thereafter. A var source only: a column is bound once per record, and a call per record would be a round trip each.

name.description: The function, optionally qualified. One or more identifiers separated by dots - this is the only part of a value source that reaches the statement text, so it is held to being a name.

type.description: What the function returns. Required, unlike a field selector's type: the OUT parameter is registered before the call, so there is nothing to infer it from.

args.description: The arguments, each a source evaluated with no record in hand.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

varLookup.description: A value read from a reference table, keyed by exactly one source. The var flavour: no fieldSelector at any depth, since a var is evaluated before the first record is read.

column.description: The column whose value is taken.

keyColumn.description: The column the key is matched against.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

varSource.description: One source, evaluated with no record in hand - so anything but a fieldSelector.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.

transform.description: A procedure in the target database, called once after every mapping has run and before the load is committed, through JDBC's {call name(?)} escape. It returns nothing - a value wanted from the database is a var with an fn in it. A procedure that fails rolls the whole load back.

name.description: The procedure, optionally qualified. One or more identifiers separated by dots - this reaches the statement text, so it is held to being a name.

args.description: The arguments, each a source evaluated with no record in hand - the load is over. ${xldr.rowsLoaded} is available to an expression here and nowhere else.

comment.description: A note for whoever reads the spec next. Ignored by the reader; declared here so that an annotation is allowed where any other unknown member is refused as a likely misspelling.
